description:
Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The digital newsletter, previously published monthly, will shift to four issues per year starting fiscal year 2026 (Reiwa 8) as we review and refresh the content.

Going forward, information about seminars, subsidies, and other updates will be posted regularly on the Chamber of Commerce and Industry website under "Latest News."

We will continue to provide richer and more substantial content, and we appreciate your continued readership.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2407/
